svg.title: Works with the tools you already use
svg.desc: Velune connects to 18 model providers (4 local, 14 cloud), to applications through opt-in integrations (Docker, HTTP, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Supabase, background processes), and speaks MCP as both server and client.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
